programs.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programs.desc: Master chef Pascal Brodnicki shows viewers how to replace traditional dishes with Asian dishes.It proves that preparing an original dinner is simple and does not have to cost much.In search of culinary inspiration, he goes to Vietnam, Laos and Thailand.He shops at local markets, prepares and sells snacks on the street, and works on a rice plantation.To prove himself, he prepares exotic dishes for his Asian hosts.He tries grilled gecko and baked ant larvae, and accepts an invitation to an unusual hunt.

programs.title: Africa Express
programs.desc:
For the first time, the race will take participants through Africa.They will cover the route through Kenya and Tanzania - from the foot of Kilimanjaro, through the crowded streets of Arusha, to the sand dunes by the Indian Ocean and historic Mombasa, ending the competition in Nairobi.Eight couples: Ewa Gawryluk-Domaniecka with her husband Piotr Domaniecki, Edyta Zając with her partner Michał Mikołajczak, Nikodem Rozbicki with her friend Paweł Kurkowski, Wiktoria Gąsiewska with her brother Mateusz Gąsiewski, Tomasz Iwan with her partner Karolina Woźniak, Katarzyna Niezgoda with her husband Paweł Markiewicz, Izu Ugonoh with his wife Antonina Ugonoh and MonikaHoffman-Piszora, together with her sister Iga Hoffman, faces the challenges of harsh, unpredictable nature - lack of roads, difficult access to water and communication, time pressure and their own emotions.The program will be hosted by Iza Krzan.Every day, participants must demonstrate perseverance, cooperation and resilience, learning about completely different faces of Africa.It's a test of boundaries and a lesson in friendship
In the seventh episode, the race moves to Kenya, where the participants face new challenges.First, they must memorize and recreate the national symbols of the African country, which gives them the chance to enter the Watamu facility and confront snakes while cleaning the terrariums.Then it's time for an exciting amulet game on the picturesque Love Island beach.Tension mounts as couples decide to draw prizes and punishments in envelopes - each of which can bring both benefits and unexpected difficulties.The competition ends with demanding tasks in the cashew cooperative and a surprising finale in the fort in Mombasa, where participants will have to face a false checkpoint and fight to reach the finish line.

programs.title: Success knows no limits
programs.desc: The second season of the program about Poles who decided to put everything on one card and prove that the life of an emigrant can be full of success.This season, Tomasz Kin will once again meet extraordinary people who found their happiness abroad.The protagonist of the series will include Radosław Malinowski, a lawyer living in Nairobi, who helps victims of human trafficking.Viewers will also meet Mieczysław Sobczak, known as Dziki Mietek, who lives in Peru and is a renowned local shaman and herbalist.The creators of the documentary will also present a hockey coach living in Canada - Jarosław Byrski.His pupils include:such stars as: Brent Burns, Bryan Bickell, and Rick Nash.
